data.name: Cowboy and Zombies
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a thrilling journey in this action-packed game set in the Wild West! Become a fearless gunslinger who has to survive an onslaught of the undead after hordes of living мертвецы invade your settlement. Test your survival skills as you fend off waves of the undead swarming towards your ranch. The ultimate goal is to last as long as possible, blasting away hordes of zombies.

Each successful kill earns you dollars, which you can use to upgrade your weapons and increase your chances of survival. With simple mouse controls, you can switch between three different weapons (revolver, shotgun, and assault rifle), each with its own unique advantages.

Refine your reflexes and prepare for intense, action-packed battles in the spirit of the Wild West. Can you protect your home from the horror that threatens to destroy it?

This indie gem is a perfect blend of action, adventure, and survival horror. Experience a story-rich environment, tense moments, and exciting challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a fan of action-packed shooters or immersive survival games, this game offers an unforgettable experience.

Join the adventure now and prove your worth in this battle for survival!
